main_measure.name: slope of next-day return minus drift against forecast, on forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: slope t (by day) >= 2 confirms (with supporting check); <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return, t by day

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the slope's t is >= 2 and the weighted mean excess return is > 0 with t >= 2.
reading: Every bar with forecast > 0 and a next close in its window is a case (1-bar horizon, so the grid is every bar), drift is the coin's mean next-day return over all its windows, both t's sum each day's contributions across coins into one cluster (with the G/(G-1) correction), and the plan's 'fewer than 300 days' is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0002362 on the check folds against +0.0003977 on every fold
